name: konsey
description: Claude, Codex ve Antigravity ajanlarini tek bir proje uzerinde koordine eden Mac uygulamasi

scripts.copy:ui: mkdir -p dist/ui && cp ui/index.html dist/ui/index.html && cp ui/styles.css dist/ui/styles.css && rm -rf dist/ui/assets && cp -R ui/pixel/assets dist/ui/assets
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run copy:ui && npm run build:ui
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --lib ES2022,DOM ui/renderer.ts ui/devMock.ts ui/pixel/office.ts ui/pixel/pixelFont.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.doctor: npm run build:main && node dist/src/cli.js doctor
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64
scripts.ui: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8124 --directory dist/ui
